result.summary: Found several layout and content issues: truncated restaurant names, a cut-off category chip, and a clipped promo card at the bottom of the feed.

issues.description: The third restaurant card title in 'Fastest near you' is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis or full name visible.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, shrink type slightly, or use ellipsis truncation so the name is readable.

issues.description: The category filter row shows a partial empty/white chip on the far right after 'Healthy', looking like a broken or incomplete control.
issues.suggestion: Hide overflow chips cleanly, add proper fade/scroll affordance, or ensure only full chips render in the visible area.

issues.description: The lower 'Popular right now' promo card (pizza with -20%) is heavily cropped by the bottom nav, so most of the image and any title/meta below it are not visible in the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding equal to the tab bar height so cards can scroll fully above the navigation.

issues.description: Search field placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, grocery' — 'Restarants' appears misspelled.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder to 'Restaurants, dishes, grocery'.
